themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, demonstrating capabilities like decision-making, task execution, and interaction with systems.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and review code, often acting as collaborative partners in the software development process.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles that highlight or review specific AI tools designed to aid in various research activities, from data analysis to knowledge retrieval.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Research exploring the behavior, capabilities, limitations, and user interactions with AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in information digestion.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skill requirements, and the overall labor market, including studies on job displacement and creation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles focusing on the creation and use of AI-generated or simulated users for testing, research, or content creation.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: How AI tools and techniques are being applied to product development, strategy, roadmapping, and user insights.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare different AI tools for research purposes, evaluating their features, performance, and suitability for specific tasks.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Content about using AI to automate software testing processes, including test case generation, execution, and analysis.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
